value.headline: - [ ] G079 — EXPLAIN THE GPU-SIDE MLP FUSION WIN [S032 §5]: ACCELERATOR_DISPATCH_IS_NOT_THE_COST measured the mlp gate_up PAIR lever at 17.35 us per removed dispatch against 2.64 and 2.86 for three other levers, and ruled out host overhead (flat at 1.5-1.8% of wall, moving +0.017 ms across the step that moved 1.094) and DRAM bandwidth (the eliminated input loads imply 20.55 TB/s, a 34.8x overshoot of the machine's measured 589.73 GB/s). ~84% of the largest fusion win in the graph is unexplained. S032 §5 names thirteen candidates -- A intermediate write/read deletion below DRAM, B cache pollution, C locality, D dependency-chain latency, E register/threadgroup reuse, F kernel prologue/epilogue, G occupancy, H instruction mix, I dequantization interaction, J coalescing, K compiler optimization unlocked by fusion, L producer-consumer staying in a faster hierarchy, M the abstraction itself disappearing -- and requires PREDICTING BEFORE EXPERIMENTS with controls that separate them where physically possible. Not closed until a mechanism is confirmed by a control that could have refuted it, or the remainder is stated as a number against a named list of eliminated candidates. | status: IN_PROGRESS | risk: high | tier: V2 || OPERAND REUSE IS REFUTED, TWO OF THIRTEEN CANDIDATES DOWN 2026-08-26 (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_MLP_OPERAND_REUSE_REFUTED.json): the previous receipt named the settling experiment in its own words -- 'a kernel that fuses the dispatch while still loading the input twice DOES NOT EXIST AND WAS NOT BUILT'. Built. Two arms, ONE dispatch each, same weights read, same grid and threadgroup, output identical to 1.913e-07 against a float64 oracle; the only difference is whether the input slice is loaded once for both accumulators or twice. THE CONTROL IS HARD FOR A REASON WORTH NAMING: a naive x[i] read twice is common-subexpression-eliminated and would have measured NOTHING while looking like a control, so the reload arm passes THE SAME MEMORY as two SEPARATE unaliased parameters. PREDICTED BEFORE THE RUN: reuse beats reload by 8-20% if operand reuse is the mechanism. REFUTED, and not in the predicted-null direction either -- reuse measured 0.3715 ms against reload's 0.3646, 1.9% SLOWER, with reload faster in 3 OF 3 admitted sweeps under a pre-registered quiescence gate (max_rss 0.13-0.15 GiB, 0 refused). HOW STRONG AND HOW NOT: the arms carry ~15% IQR, ABOVE the 10% gate, so no small effect is resolved in either direction and none is claimed -- what is settled is that an 8-20% advantage cannot hide behind a -1.9% median with the sign consistent 3/3 the wrong way. MECHANISM FOR THE ELIMINATION: the kernel issues 8 shift-and-mask unpacks plus 2 FMAs per byte pair, against which one extra L1 load is free -- and the regime cross-checks, 149.9 GB/s here against the 161.9 GB/s ACCELERATOR_EXPERT_BATCH independently measured for a native q4 arm it called ARITHMETIC-BOUND ON THE UNPACK, 7.4% apart from a different experiment on a different day. ELIMINATED: E (register/threadgroup reuse) and L (producer-consumer in a faster hierarchy), in the specific form the previous receipt proposed. NOT ELIMINATED AND THE CONTROL DID NOT TEST THEM: F prologue/epilogue, G occupancy, K compiler, and THE REDUCTION -- production unfused does two SEPARATE simd_sum, threadgroup reduces and writes while fused does two accumulators in ONE reduction pass, and this control held the reduction FIXED in both arms. That is now the leading candidate. THE ARM THAT WOULD SETTLE IT IS BUILT, CORRECT AND UNTIMED: a single-accumulator kernel run TWICE against the fused shape, isolating prologue + reduction + epilogue together. Its own gate returned NO ADMITTED SWEEP in a 1300 s budget -- BENCH_STATE = CONTENDED, mlx_boot holding 45.6 GiB and NOT killed, on the same rule as the lake fill. THE HARNESS REFUSING TO PRODUCE A NUMBER IS THE RESULT OF THAT RUN, which is exactly what S032 §3 asks for. NAMED GATE per §129: a quiesced window of ~90 s with no process over 2 GiB RSS. HONEST STATUS: two of thirteen eliminated by measurement, none confirmed -- less than the steer asked for and more than an untested story.

value.headline: - [ ] G080 — LM-HEAD ASCENSION [S032 §7, §8]: can the output head require less physical work WITHOUT changing model function? Separate EXACT, APPROXIMATE and TASK-CONDITIONAL methods and never call an approximate shortlist exact. Named routes: compact native head representation, fused head+selection, avoiding full-logit materialization, hierarchical two-stage exact selection, vocabulary partitioning with mathematically safe rejection bounds, grammar/structured-output-aware restriction where semantics legitimately permit, active-vocabulary routing, head factorization or low-rank structure if verified adequate, quantized head with selective healing, GPU-resident shortlist structures, cross-step reuse, and deleting the full-vocabulary operation if an exact equivalent avoids it. | status: IN_PROGRESS | risk: medium | tier: V2 || THE EXACT FAMILY IS REFUTED AND §8 IS ANSWERED BY ARITHMETIC 2026-08-26 (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_LM_HEAD_EXACT_BOUNDS_REFUTED.json, ACCELERATOR_TOKEN_BYTE_ATLAS_628.json): full-logit materialization is 0.0201% of the token's bytes and argmax fusion is worth ~0.03% of wall, so §8's boundary is real and negligible; the head's cost is reading 675,430,400 bytes of WEIGHTS. Cauchy-Schwarz pruning reduces to the row-norm distribution, measured exactly from the packed codes with no forward pass: CV 0.1288 and 0.1646, prunable 0.000-0.073% at cos 0.10 and 0.236-0.976% at 0.30, needing cos ~0.63 to prune half. The prefix bound dies with it -- energy is uniform, tail/full tracking sqrt(1-k/D) at 0.995-1.023 across k=0.25D to 0.90D. MECHANISM: no preferred magnitude and no preferred dimension subspace, so discrimination is entirely full-dimensional DIRECTION, which every norm bound discards. Both predictions were written before the run and both confirmed. WHAT SURVIVES WITH A NUMBER: the head runs 4.25 bpw while every MLP tensor in the same artifact runs 2.5 -- taking it to 2.5 saves 2.82% of the byte wall, ~94x argmax fusion and 43% of everything the fusion campaign bought. UNMEASURED and NOT assumed: its adequacy, and the head was never in the organ-floor sweep. Low-rank (§7H) is untested and this refutation says nothing about it -- a matrix can be per-row isotropic and still low rank.

Do NOT fix it by widening to all receipts and do NOT let a semantic classifier guess which civilization owns the 348 foreign ones. Establish explicit evidence registration: the receipt declares evidence_domain, civilization, program, machine_scope, representation_scope and kernel_scope, or a deterministic manifest registers it. Until then exclusions stay explicit and visible. | status: IN_PROGRESS | risk: low | tier: V2 || WORKED AROUND, NOT FIXED 2026-08-26: outside_scope_count and an explicit KNOWN_ACCELERATOR_OUTSIDE_SCOPE list report the gap, with a test that the list must SHRINK when a receipt is renamed in. Every receipt this session produced was NAMED ACCELERATOR_* so it would be seen -- which is the workaround, not the fix, and is recorded as such. The four earlier receipts (TOKEN_EXECUTION_ATLAS_COUNTS, TOKEN_GRAPH_REDUCTION_TIMED, CAPABILITY_FUSED_GRAPH_CLEARED, FUSION_GAIN_IS_LENGTH_INDEPENDENT) are still outside and still unextracted. || MEMBERSHIP NO LONGER DEPENDS ONLY ON THE FILENAME 2026-08-26 (tools/accelerator/akb.py): a receipt now DECLARES itself with an akb_registration carrying all six scopes S032 §13 names -- evidence_domain, civilization, program, machine_scope, representation_scope, kernel_scope -- and an INCOMPLETE declaration buys nothing, because a receipt naming its domain and nothing else would join the corpus while telling the reader nothing about what its evidence covers. Pinned by a test that drops each of the six in turn and requires refusal, plus one that refuses another campaign's evidence_domain. THE FOUR INVISIBLE RECEIPTS ARE IN, AND IN BY DECLARING RATHER THAN BY BEING RENAMED: TOKEN_EXECUTION_ATLAS_COUNTS, TOKEN_GRAPH_REDUCTION_TIMED, CAPABILITY_FUSED_GRAPH_CLEARED and FUSION_GAIN_IS_LENGTH_INDEPENDENT, plus HCLI_RESIDENT_SEAL. Corpus 83 -> 88. Becoming visible immediately cost them a decision, which is the system working: the tripwire refused all five as UNCLASSIFIED, and two became LAWS (964 dispatches/token measured with both layer kinds costing 15 by DIFFERENT routes; the fusion gain length-independent 64-1024 at 2.1-2.3%) while three took reasons -- two SUPERSEDED_IN_FLIGHT because later receipts refuted their numbers, and the seal SUBSUMED because it derives from receipts already in the corpus and carries no new measurement. THE LEGACY ROUTE IS NOT DELETED AND IS REPORTED: 83 of 88 still arrive by the glob, and membership_routes prints that count because it is the size of the remaining name dependence and a silent one is a gap nobody can close; a test asserts it is non-zero with the comment that hitting zero is a GOOD failure. AND A TEST OF MINE ASSERTED THE OPPOSITE AND WAS RIGHT TO UNTIL IT WASN'T: test_the_corpus_scope_is_a_filename_prefix_and_says_so was true when written and became a TRANSIENT FACT ENCODED AS A LAW, the same shape this program caught when a test asserted unmeasured gaps outnumber measured ones. value.headline: - [ ] G082 — CAPABILITY IS A PERFORMANCE LEVER TOWARD >=36/43 [S032 §14, §15]: raw TPS is near a physical bandwidth ceiling, so capability now buys accepted TPS directly. The threshold at which 50 accepted becomes theoretically reachable at 3.1393 EBPW is ~36.02/43. Maintain a BOUNDED capability lane prioritising the axes that matter operationally to HCLI -- structured output, tool-like formatting, instruction adherence, answer transition -- using targeted information injection and execution-semantic repair rather than a global precision increase. Every capability gain reports bytes added, EBPW delta, raw TPS delta and accepted TPS delta. | status: IN_PROGRESS | risk: medium | tier: V2 || 30 -> 35 FOR ZERO BYTES 2026-08-26 (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_RESIDENT_TEMPLATE_ARM.json): the pre_closed_think chat-template arm scores 35/43 against open_think's 30/43 on the SAME artifact -- bytes added 0, EBPW delta 0, raw TPS delta +1.003% (the shorter render carries a shorter KV), accepted TPS 24.65 -> 29.05 arm-matched. structured_output 5/15 -> 10/15 and empty replies 8 -> 0. cap/EBPW moves from 83.3% to 97.2% of the 11.473 that 50 accepted requires. SHORT BY 1.02 CAPABILITY POINTS, and json-answer is 5 of them, failing only because the model omits two EMPTY JSON ARRAYS the system prompt asked for -- prompt adherence, not density. CORRECTIONS THAT CAME WITH IT: 43 cases are 11 ITEMS (greedy at temperature 0 makes every repeat byte-identical), so the five-point move is ONE item weighted five; 3 of 43 on BOTH arms are a leak check the harness disarms before scoring; and the budget confound gives the LOSING arm 3x the tokens.

value.headline: - [ ] G083 — HCLI USES ITS RESIDENT AND ABSORBS EXPERIMENT CYCLES [S032 §18, §19]: once sealed, HCLI makes sealed-3.14 its canonical cheap resident thinker and real bounded Accelerator work is delegated into it -- inspect a hot kernel family, generate candidate kernels, run a deterministic benchmark matrix, classify results, write provisional hypotheses, return a verified receipt. Claude remains principal. Blocked behind the known delegation defect: repo-relative verifier paths do not resolve from an isolated delegation workspace, which G076 must repair without removing isolation by establishing explicit REPO_ROOT, MISSION_ROOT and WORKSPACE_ROOT with deterministic resolution, mutation-tested against a wrong repo root, traversal, a stale cwd, a missing verifier and a duplicate writer. Not closed until ONE real Accelerator mission runs end to end through HCLI and its verifier classification is correct. | status: IN_PROGRESS | risk: medium | tier: V2 || UNBLOCKED ON ONE SIDE 2026-08-26: the resident is SEALED (receipts/headless/HCLI_RESIDENT_SEAL.json, G071) with one canonical declaration and 23 derived fields, so 'which body is resident' is answered. G076's path defect is untouched. || THE BLOCKER IS CLOSED, THE OBLIGATION IS NOT 2026-08-26 (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_SEALED_RESIDENT_ENDPOINT.json, tools/hcli_resident/serve_sealed.py): HCLI talks to an OPENAI-COMPATIBLE ENDPOINT and the sealed resident had none -- it is a Rust greedy example, and `hawking gravity serve` wants model-*.gravity shards that DO NOT EXIST because every Hawking body on disk is .hq30uq4 / .f32v2 / .hgrafv01. That is the concrete gap that has kept the fast body and the OpenAI surface from ever talking, and it was never architectural. /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models now sit over the sealed binary with no second runtime invented and no change to the resident. THE SERVER REFUSES TO START UNLESS DISK MATCHES THE SEAL -- runtime binary sha256 byte for byte, tokenizer and chat template hashes, the 628-dispatch graph, the pre_closed_think arm, the four fusion levers -- because a shim that silently serves a DIFFERENT configuration makes every number downstream describe something nobody sealed, and this session already killed a capability run mid-flight when a rebuild changed the binary hash underneath it. EVERY mismatch is reported, not the first. --allow-unsealed serves anyway and stamps sealed:false on EVERY RESPONSE so the divergence travels with the output. A SAMPLER REQUEST IS REFUSED RATHER THAN IGNORED, because the sealed path is greedy argmax and honouring temperature silently is how a benchmark measures a different sampler than it asked for. AND THE FIRST VERSION OF THAT GUARD HAD A REAL HOLE: the check was `body[k] not in (None, 1, False)` and IN PYTHON TRUE == 1, so `stream: true` passed and the request WAS SERVED NON-STREAMED WITH A 200 -- the caller silently given something other than what it asked for. Caught by the mutation test, whose 13-second duration was the tell before its assertion was, because it actually ran the model; fixed with a type-aware per-key table and pinned by its own test, since the bug was in the COMPARISON not the list. The suite now runs in 0.10 s, which is itself the evidence that every refusal happens BEFORE the model is invoked. IDENTITY TRAVELS WITH EVERY RESPONSE (artifact sha, binary sha, arm, dispatches, fallbacks, dense_w) because a caller that logs only the text cannot later say which body produced it -- the exact defect G073 found across every CAPABILITY_noetic-* receipt -- and wall_s is LABELLED not-a-TPS-figure in the response body, since the binary reloads the model per call. The think-block rule is capability_suite's rule reused deliberately so the server and the suite cannot disagree about what a reply is. 10 tests, 608 across the suites. STILL OPEN AND THIS IS THE OBLIGATION: NO REAL MISSION HAS RUN END TO END. G083 asks for one bounded Accelerator mission with a correct verifier classification, and the endpoint existing is not that.
